title: Agent Workbench Capstone
motto: The mini-track ends with a pack you drop into any repo. Eleven lessons of surfaces compressed into a directory you can `cp -r` and have an agent working reliably the next morning. The capstone is the artifact this curriculum trades on.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: The mini-track ends with a pack you drop into any repo. Eleven lessons of surfaces compressed into a directory you can `cp -r` and have an agent working reliably the next morning. The capstone is the artifact this curriculum trades on.

steps.title: The problem
cards: A workbench that lives in a Google Doc, a chat history, and three half-remembered scripts is a workbench that gets rebuilt every quarter. The cure is a versioned pack: a repo or directory with the surfaces, the schemas, the scripts, and a one-command installer.
You will end this lesson with `outputs/agent-workbench-pack/` shipped on disk and a `bin/install.sh` that drops it into any target repo.

steps.title: Lesson overview complete
